review_notes: I read the whole file. Its only new concept is `diagCosetGamma0`, the Γ₀(N) analogue of the TauCeti level-one `diagCoset`. It is built on Mathlib's `HeckeCoset.mk`, `DoubleCoset.doubleCoset` and `Delta0` through the existing `natDiagGL`. A grep of Mathlib found `HeckeCoset` only in `Mathlib/NumberTheory/HeckeRing/Defs.lean`, which this file reuses. Mathlib has no `natDiagGL` or `diagCoset` counterpart. The lemmas `diagCosetGamma0_def`, `_one` and `_of_not_pos` are API for a named definition, not copies of a Mathlib concept. I did not look for duplicates inside TauCeti, because the rubric concerns Mathlib, Batteries and core. I found no avoidable competing version of an existing concept.
